text: The light of the sect, the {light}, stands in {pname} (place {place}), one of the places of authority.
plain: The {light}, the main light of a {daynight} chart, stands in one of the strongest parts of the sky.
crude: The {light} is running this {daynight} chart and it's parked in one of the power seats of the sky. Ptolemy would nod approvingly, and he didn't nod at much.
basis: Ptolemy (places of authority, preference of the sect light)

text: Both luminaries are in masculine signs ({sun_sign}, {moon_sign}) and {which} angular: Ptolemy's first testimony of dignity.
plain: The Sun and the Moon both stand in 'masculine' constellations, and {which_plain} on an angle of the chart: Ptolemy's first sign of rank and standing.
crude: Sun and Moon both in 'masculine' constellations and {which_plain} on an angle. In Ptolemy's book that's how kings get made. You're probably not a king, but hey, it's a damn good look.

text: The {light}, light of the sect, is attended by {planets} ({how}): an attendance of beneficent planets gives "greater independence and security".
plain: The {light}, the chart's main light, is backed up by {planets}, the kindly planets, which Ptolemy says brings more independence and security.
crude: The {light} has {planets} riding shotgun. The nice planets have its back, so for once the sky isn't trying to screw you.
basis: Ptolemy; attendance read as an aspect within the moieties (app rule)

text: {planet}, a beneficent planet, is angular, in {pname} (place {place}): planets are most powerful at the angles.
plain: {planet}, one of the two kindly planets, sits on an angle of the chart, where planets are at their strongest.
crude: {planet}, one of the good guys, is sitting right on an angle with the volume turned up. That's a gift. Don't waste the bloody thing.
source: Tetrabiblos I.5, Loeb p.39; I.24, Loeb p.117

text: {lord}, ruler of the horoscope by {ways}, is in an honourable position (net {n:+d}), in {pname}.
plain: {lord}, the planet that rules the rising point and stands for you, is in good shape (score {n:+d}).
crude: {lord}, the planet standing in for you, is in fine form: {n:+d} on the board. Look at you, not screwing it up for once.
source: Tetrabiblos III.2-III.3, Loeb pp.233-239; I.24, Loeb p.117
basis: Ptolemy (five ways of domination); points: app weights

text: {ruler}, lord of the sign of the Lot of Fortune ({fsign}), is in power (net {n:+d}): "when the planets which govern the Lot of Fortune are in power, they make the subjects rich".
plain: {ruler}, the planet that rules the Lot of Fortune, is strong (score {n:+d}). Ptolemy reads this as good for money and possessions.
crude: {ruler} runs your Lot of Fortune and it's strong ({n:+d}). Ptolemy says that means money. Don't go buying a damn yacht on the strength of a 2nd-century book, though.
basis: Ptolemy; "in power" = net score above zero (app rule)

text: The Moon is increasing in illumination ({lit}% lit): towards "greater natural endowments, renown, firmness, and frankness".
plain: The Moon is growing ({lit}% lit), which Ptolemy links with natural gifts, good name, steadiness and openness.
crude: The Moon's getting fatter ({lit}% lit). Ptolemy says that means talent, a good name and backbone. Lucky you, apparently.

text: {planet}, a maleficent planet, is angular, in {pname} (place {place}){sect_note}.
plain: {planet}, one of the two harsh planets, sits on an angle of the chart, where it is at full strength{sect_plain}.
crude: {planet}, one of the two cosmic assholes, is sitting on an angle at full power{sect_plain}. Brace yourself.
source: Tetrabiblos I.5, Loeb p.39; I.7, Loeb p.43; I.24, Loeb p.117

text: The {light} is afflicted by {planet} ({aspect}, {dev:.1f}° from exact): an attendance of maleficent planets brings "dependency and less security".
plain: {planet}, a harsh planet, is pressing on the {light} ({aspect}). Ptolemy reads this as less security and more dependence on others.
crude: {planet} is leaning on the {light} like a drunk at a bus stop ({aspect}). Ptolemy says that means less security. Lock your damn doors.
basis: Ptolemy; aspect within the moieties (app rule)

plain: Neither the Sun nor the Moon is on an angle of the chart{extra_plain}.
crude: Neither the Sun nor the Moon could be bothered to haul its ass onto an angle{extra_plain}. Low-key day, then.

text: {lord}, ruler of the horoscope by {ways}, is in a position of the opposite kind (net {n:+d}), in {pname}.
plain: {lord}, the planet that rules the rising point and stands for you, is in poor shape (score {n:+d}).
crude: {lord}, your stand-in planet, is having a crap time of it: {n:+d}. Not your fault. Probably.
source: Tetrabiblos III.2-III.3, Loeb pp.233-239; I.24, Loeb p.117
basis: Ptolemy (five ways of domination); points: app weights

text: {lord}, ruler of the horoscope, is in {pname} (place {place}), which bears no aspect to the orient: "if they bear no aspect at all to the orient they are entirely powerless".
plain: {lord}, the planet that stands for you, sits in a part of the chart that cannot 'see' the rising point, which Ptolemy says leaves a planet powerless.
crude: {lord}, your planet, is stuck in a corner of the sky that can't even see the horizon. Ptolemy calls that 'entirely powerless'. Ouch.
basis: Ptolemy; aspect by whole place (app rule)

text: {ruler}, lord of the sign of the Lot of Fortune ({fsign}), is weak (net {n:+d}): the governors of Fortune are not in power.
plain: {ruler}, the planet that rules the Lot of Fortune, is weak (score {n:+d}). Ptolemy would not promise riches from it.
crude: {ruler} runs your Lot of Fortune and it's flat on its arse ({n:+d}). Keep your wallet in your pocket.
basis: Ptolemy; "weak" = net score below zero (app rule)

text: The Moon is waning ({lit}% lit): towards "greater sluggishness and dullness, less fixity of purpose, greater cautiousness, and less renown".
plain: The Moon is shrinking ({lit}% lit), which Ptolemy links with sluggishness, wavering and caution.
crude: The Moon's shrinking ({lit}% lit). Ptolemy says that means sluggish, dithering and cautious. So, a Monday.

text: {planet} is in the House of the Evil Daemon (place 12), which "injures the emanation from the stars in it to the earth".
plain: {planet} sits in the 12th place, which Ptolemy says spoils the influence of any planet in it.
crude: {planet} is stuck in the House of the Evil Daemon. Yes, that's the real name. Ptolemy says it ruins whatever's in there.

text: {con} rises. It has no sign in Ptolemy, so the horoscope has no ruler by house, triangle, exaltation or terms.
plain: {con} is rising. It is not one of Ptolemy's twelve signs, so no planet rules the rising point and stands for you.
crude: {con} is rising, and Ptolemy never heard of it as a sign. No planet stands for you, so half the tests go straight in the bin.
basis: app rule (the IAU constellation Ophiuchus has no sign in Ptolemy)

text: {planet} is in Ophiuchus, which has no sign in Ptolemy: it has no familiarity there.
plain: {planet} is in Ophiuchus, a constellation that is not one of Ptolemy's signs, so it has no home there.
crude: {planet} has wandered into Ophiuchus, which isn't even a sign in Ptolemy's book. Lost, basically.
